api/src/jobs/schedulers/__init__.py.name: Schedulers package
api/src/jobs/schedulers/__init__.py.description: Groups the tasks that run automatically on a timetable.

api/src/jobs/schedulers/artifact_retenti.name: Artifact cleanup schedule
api/src/jobs/schedulers/artifact_retenti.description: Starts the daily removal of expired chat files.

api/src/jobs/schedulers/audit_archive.py.name: Audit archive schedule
api/src/jobs/schedulers/audit_archive.py.description: Starts the daily move of older audit history into long-term storage.

api/src/jobs/schedulers/cron_scheduler.p.name: Cron triggers
api/src/jobs/schedulers/cron_scheduler.p.description: Runs workflows set to start on a timetable, at the times their schedule says.

api/src/jobs/schedulers/deferred_executi.name: Starting due runs
api/src/jobs/schedulers/deferred_executi.description: Releases runs whose scheduled time has arrived and hands them to the executors.

api/src/jobs/schedulers/event_cleanup.py.name: Stuck event cleanup
api/src/jobs/schedulers/event_cleanup.py.description: Closes out event deliveries whose run has already finished, checking every few minutes.

api/src/jobs/schedulers/execution_cleanu.name: Stuck run cleanup
api/src/jobs/schedulers/execution_cleanu.description: Ends workflow runs and agent runs left in progress long after they should have finished.

api/src/jobs/schedulers/knowledge_storag.name: Knowledge storage totals
api/src/jobs/schedulers/knowledge_storag.description: Counts each workspace's stored knowledge daily so its usage is visible.

api/src/jobs/schedulers/kubernetes_jobs..name: Hosted build watcher
api/src/jobs/schedulers/kubernetes_jobs..description: Watches long platform tasks running on hosted machines and keeps their status current without tying up local capacity.

api/src/jobs/schedulers/logo_thumbnail_b.name: Logo thumbnail catch-up
api/src/jobs/schedulers/logo_thumbnail_b.description: Gradually creates missing logo thumbnails for workspaces that were set up before thumbnails existed.

api/src/jobs/schedulers/metrics_refresh..name: Platform metrics refresh
api/src/jobs/schedulers/metrics_refresh..description: Updates the dashboard's platform-wide numbers on a timetable.

api/src/jobs/schedulers/oauth_token_refr.name: Connected service renewal
api/src/jobs/schedulers/oauth_token_refr.description: Refreshes connected-service sign-ins before they expire so automations keep working.

api/src/jobs/schedulers/platform_jobs.py.name: Long task runner
api/src/jobs/schedulers/platform_jobs.py.description: Claims queued long-running platform tasks and runs them in a process that can be stopped safely.

api/src/jobs/schedulers/run_retention.py.name: Run retention schedule
api/src/jobs/schedulers/run_retention.py.description: Starts the daily deletion of runs and events past the retention window.

api/src/jobs/schedulers/solution_export_.name: Solution backup jobs
api/src/jobs/schedulers/solution_export_.description: Builds Solution backup files and clears out old ones while keeping the record of past jobs.

api/src/jobs/schedulers/solution_update_.name: Solution update checks
api/src/jobs/schedulers/solution_update_.description: Checks Git-connected Solutions for newer versions and flags the ones that can be updated.

api/src/jobs/schedulers/usage_reporting..name: Usage report schedule
api/src/jobs/schedulers/usage_reporting..description: Sends the anonymous daily usage count at the end of each day.

api/src/jobs/schedulers/webhook_renewal..name: Message subscription renewal
api/src/jobs/schedulers/webhook_renewal..description: Renews message subscriptions before they lapse so incoming updates keep arriving.

api/src/jobs/schedulers/worker_metrics_c.name: Worker metrics cleanup
api/src/jobs/schedulers/worker_metrics_c.description: Deletes worker performance records older than a week.

api/src/jobs/schedulers/worker_metrics_s.name: Worker metrics sampling
api/src/jobs/schedulers/worker_metrics_s.description: Records each worker's latest heartbeat numbers for the performance view.

api/src/jobs/schedulers/workflow_operati.name: Usage counter flush
api/src/jobs/schedulers/workflow_operati.description: Saves today's and yesterday's workflow usage counts so none are lost.

api/src/jobs/schedulers/workspace_bundle.name: Bundle staging cleanup
api/src/jobs/schedulers/workspace_bundle.description: Removes leftover temporary files from Solution imports.
